content:
The NexString construction style (traditionally known as a closed string staircase) is the NEX-branded approach to enclosed outer string staircases. It represents the premium tier of NEX's Connected Staircase family.

Every NexString staircase is designed around the available space rather than fitted from a catalogue. See https://asknex.app/uk/staircases for the customer-facing guide.
